description.value: Meridian Farm Market is a BC-based farm market chain emphasising locally sourced and sustainably raised products, including grass-fed beef, free-run chicken, local pork, fresh produce, artisan deli items, and a full bake shoppe. The Tsawwassen outlet is one of several Lower Mainland locations and stocks a wide range of fresh, packaged, and frozen goods well suited to restocking a loaded touring bike. The brand's farm-fresh focus means cyclists are likely to find higher-quality local provisions than a typical chain supermarket.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 55m; rack at 66m. Total: 5 spaces.
